title: Tech Note: Creating a Custom File Explorer
author: Erick Lui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: The object-notation File/Folder command family (folder.folders(), folder.files(), folder.create(), folder.delete()) introduced around v17R5 is still the current, standard way to do file-system operations in 4D — this note remains fully applicable today with no significant API changes.
related_updates: File/Folder object commands remain the standard 4D file-system API; no deprecation since introduction
Collection-based list boxes are still the recommended list box paradigm over classic array-based list boxes
